answer: Sybil resistance via remote hardware attestation: new agents dock at a registration wharf and must present a fresh TEE quote binding their public key to a manufacturer-backed measurement. Only one live quote per sealed device is admitted; the garden of attested identities grows only when quotes verify against a rotating nonce. Unattested traffic stays in the ocean of untrusted peers and cannot mint reputation or grade seats. Cloning a key without the hardware fails quote checks, so farmed identities collapse at the wharf gate.
